state = {
  lat: 37.3688, lon: -122.0363, place: 'Sunnyvale',
  tz: 'America/Los_Angeles',                          // IANA zone (DST-correct via Intl)
  utcOffset: -new Date().getTimezoneOffset() * 60,    // fallback, seconds east of UTC
  temp: 18, code: 1, cloud: 25,
  wind: 9, windDir: 250,                              // km/h, meteorological degrees
  aqi: 35,                                            // US AQI
  sim: null,                                          // WMO code override, null = live
  windSim: null,                                      // manual wind km/h, null = auto
  aqiSim: null,                                       // manual AQI, null = auto
  cloudSim: null,                                     // manual cloud cover %, null = auto
  stagedCloud: false,                                 // custom-time 42% default active (until Live chip)
  aodSim: null,                                       // manual aerosol depth, null = auto
  dateSim: null,                                      // 'YYYY-MM-DD' simulated date, null = today
  timeFlow: 1,                                        // custom-time speed: hours advance at Nx real time
  aod: null,                                          // live aerosol optical depth @550nm, null = derived
  humidity: null,                                     // live relative humidity %, haze fallback input
  cloudLow: null, cloudMid: null, cloudHigh: null,    // cover by layer: deck thinness signal
  visibility: null,                                   // meters — measured clarity, feeds haze
  diffuseFrac: null,                                  // diffuse/(direct+diffuse): deck optical thickness
  skyTransmit: null,                                  // arriving/clear-sky light: deck brightness
  snowDepth: null,                                    // m — snowy ground brightens the deck
  cape: null, gusts: null,                            // stashed for storm flicker / cloud turbulence
  /* cirrus look, live-tunable from the native debug panel (code-owned
     defaults, not persisted — the owner's tuning pattern) */
  cirrus: { angle: 15, variance: 8, fiber: 1.1, opacity: 0.53, cover: -0.17, evolve: 0.008, breakDepth: 0.44, grain: 2.8 },
  /* godray look, live-tunable from the native debug panel (the cirrus
     pattern: code-owned defaults, tuned by the owner, then baked) */
  rays: { strength: 0.1, scale: 8, falloff: 6 },    // owner-tuned 2026-09-22 (strength 0.55→0.1 beside the purity map); scale/falloff 2026-08-26
  /* 22° halo look, live-tunable (radius 0.196 = 22° × 0.80/90 via the
     bodyY mapping); force pins to 100% for tuning (weather bypassed,
     sun-up fade kept). Ships ON at a delicate strength. */
  halo: { strength: 0.25, radius: 0.28, dispersion: 1.7, force: false },  // owner-tuned 2026-09-22 (strength 0.9→0.25 beside the purity map); radius/dispersion 2026-08-26
  /* clear-sky purity (phenomena plan, step 0 — L&L §2.2): the Rayleigh
     purity map P(θ) — 0 at the sun, 1 at 90° from it — drives the
     POLARIZER BAND (and next the aureole). polarizer = the dial: 0 is the
     eye's sky, 1 a full polarizing filter; force pins the dial value
     (turbidity/deck bypassed, the daylight fade kept). Code-owned
     defaults, tuned live from the native panel, then baked. */
  purity: { polarizer: 0.9,                   // owner-tuned 2026-09-22 ("deeper blues"; 0.8 → 0.9 with the aureole in)
            aureole: 0.6, aureoleWidth: 10,   // owner-tuned 2026-09-22: strength dial, base half-width in degrees (pristine air)
            horizon: 0.25,                    // owner-tuned 2026-09-22: horizon whitening by optical depth (τ-saturation)
            /* clear-sky twilight (phenomena plan step 2 — L&L §2.14, Minnaert §221) */
            purple: 0.3, purpleHeight: 30, purpleWidth: 16,  // owner-tuned 2026-09-22: purple-light lobe strength, center altitude (°), σ (°)
            crep: 0.4, crepScale: 5,                         // owner-tuned 2026-09-22: crepuscular shadow fan strength, angular noise scale
            force: false },
  lutAmt: 0,   // owner LUT mix — set from LUT_AMT_DEFAULT at boot, live via hark.setLutAmt
  /* SCENE SCALE (owner, 2026-09-22: "contain the details, fit the sky to
     the height"): the SKY always spans the window — horizon at the bottom
     band, zenith near the top, everything horizon-anchored scales with the
     height. The DETAILS (cloud field, glow body, halo, aureole, polarizer
     arc, twilight lobe and fan) live in a unit that is the TIGHTER of the
     height and the width ÷ aspect: on a landscape window the height wins
     and the look is exactly the tuned one; on a phone-shaped window the
     width wins, so the composition around the sun and along the horizon
     shrinks to stay in frame instead of being cropped at the sides.
     aspect = the composition's reference width in heights (1.0 = a
     square composition must fit). crop = how far back toward the old
     height rule a narrow window goes: 0 keeps the whole composition in
     frame, 1 crops it exactly as before; the owner wants "a little bit
     of cropping" (2026-09-22). */
  scene: { aspect: 1.0, crop: 0.15 },   // owner-tuned 2026-09-22 ("this behavior is perfect")
  /* CLOUD LIGHTING + LOW SUN (phenomena plan — L&L §4.18–4.20, §2.6),
     dials, code-owned defaults (0 = layer off until the owner picks):
     thin     — thin cloud darkens toward the sky behind it instead of adding white
     back     — sun-side back-lighting: dark cores, bright rims, glare through thin cloud;
                front-lit thick cloud whitens
     hiTint   — split low-sun tint: cirrus stays lit and colored ~2° longer than the deck
     airlight — blue airlight bias on the low-sun horizon band ("purple mountain")
     red      — aerosol reddening of the disk with air mass (the PHYSICAL excess over the
                display axis), so hazy sunsets go deep red and dim earlier */
  cloudLit: { thin: 0.75, back: 1.0, hiTint: 0.5, airlight: 0.8, red: 1.0 },   // owner-tuned 2026-09-22
  /* twilight afterglow, act 2 (re-illumination) — the owner's dial for how
     BRIGHT the re-lit clouds get (1 = the 2026-08 tuning, 0.25 = the owner's
     2026-09-22 pick); the rose color and the timing are untouched by it */
  afterglow: { lift: 0.25 },   // owner-tuned 2026-09-22 (re-lit clouds were too bright)
  /* NIGHT FLOOR (owner, 2026-09-22: "around 4:30 AM we dip too deep into
     black"): once the moon has set nothing lifts the night — the grade's
     linear floor is tiny and sits BEFORE the vignette, the mottle and the
     LUT, which all push the darkest pixels below it. This is a DISPLAY-side
     floor at the very end of the shader: the deepest night is a very dark
     blue, never black, so the glass UI keeps its contrast. floor = the
     dial, 0 → near-black (#05070f-ish), 1 → dark navy (#17204a-ish), the
     owner's pick 0.2; zenith a touch darker than the horizon. Gated to
     night on the CPU. */
  night: { floor: 0.2 },   // owner-tuned 2026-09-22
  /* SUNDOGS (L&L §5.8): parhelia from horizontally floating plate crystals —
     two bright spots at the sun's altitude, 22° out at a low sun and
     drifting outward and fainter as it climbs, gone near 61°. strength =
     the dial, tail = the white tail's length in degrees, force = bypass
     the halo's weather gates (the sun-up fade and the geometry stay). */
  dogs: { strength: 0.9, tail: 4.1, force: false },   // owner-tuned 2026-09-22
  /* CORONAE (L&L §4.13): diffraction rings around the sun or moon seen
     through thin altocumulus — a bluish-white aureole and one pale rust
     ring a few degrees out. radius = the ring's angular radius (deg, the
     day seed jitters it ±25% as drop size would), purity = how uniform
     the drops are (pure → narrower, redder ring with a faint inner band),
     force = bypass the cloud gates. Mostly the moon's; the sun's glare
     leaves only a faint aureole by day. */
  corona: { strength: 0.1, radius: 6, purity: 0.6, force: false },   // owner-tuned 2026-09-22
  skyglow: null,          // measured city light 0–1 (Black Marble sample), snapshot-persisted
  skyglowStrength: 0.3,   // the dial: how much realism eats the dark night canvas
  haveWx: false, updated: null,
  live: true, hourOverride: 12,
  wTime: 1.0, wCond: 1.0, wTemp: 0.8,     // influence weights (fixed in code)
  density: 0.9, flow: 1.7, speed: 2.5, grain: 0.018,
  shaftStr: 1.1, shaftCov: 0.5, shaftReach: 1.0
}
